issues.explanation: In this poem, 滚滚 means surging or rolling, not a panda nickname or a name.
Here 东 means eastward, not the surname Dong.
Here 水 means water, not the surname Shui.
This is a verb plus result complement: 淘 means wash away and 尽 means completely; the combined gloss hides the useful complement.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 淘（wash away）+ 尽（completely）

issues.explanation: In 转头空, 转 means turn/change, not the unrelated dictionary reference shown.
In the poem, 青山 is the ordinary phrase “green hills,” not the administrative place name Qingshan.
几 means several/how many here, not a small table.
度 is a measure word meaning times in 几度夕阳红, not a particle meaning “to pass.”
红 means red here, not the surname Hong.
看 means watch or view in 惯看秋月春风, not “to look after.”
喜 means be glad or delighted here, not “to be fond of.”
都 means all here, not the surname Du.
付 means consign or leave over to in 都付笑谈中, not the surname Fu.
中 means in or among here, not the bound form for China.
In 分久必合, 合 means unite or come together, not the measure “100 ml.”
In 合久必分, 合 again means unite or remain united, not the measure “100 ml.”

现 means appear or manifest here; the current gloss is acceptable only if it reflects that event, but this row's isolated gloss should not imply a modern everyday sense. This is a minor issue and does not materially mislead.
青 means blue-green here, not an abbreviation for Qinghai.
化 means transform into or change into in 鸡化雄, not a variant of 花.
干政 uses 干 in the sense of interfere in or meddle with, not the surname Gan.
被 is the passive marker here, not “quilt.” The existing 被陷害 overlay correctly explains the construction, but the lexical row is wrong.
反 is an adverb meaning instead/on the contrary in 反被陷害, not a particle.
回 means return here, not circle.
等 means and others/et cetera here, not “to wait for.”
结党 means form or join a clique; 结 does not mean produce fruit here.
党 means clique or faction here, not the surname Dang.
信张让 means trust or believe Zhang Rang, not “letter.”
日 means increasingly or day by day in 朝政日坏, not an abbreviation for Japan.
人 means a native of and 张角 is the person's name; grouping them as one name hides the ordinary geographic-origin construction.
issues.suggested_fix: Split as 人（person/native of）+ 张角（Zhang Jiao）

issues.explanation: 山 means mountain here, not the surname Shan.
遇 means encounter here, not the surname Yu.
In 南华老仙, 南华 is part of the immortal's epithet, not “South China.”
The pinyin does not correspond to the segment 老仙; it incorrectly includes 南华.
得 is the verb obtain/get here, not a particle.
三 means three, not the surname San.
卷 is a measure word for books or scrolls here; pinyin bèi is incorrect.
天书 means celestial or divine book/text here, not an imperial edict.
符水 is talisman water or ritual water; 符 is not the surname Fu here.
水 means water in 符水, not the surname Shui.
和 means and here, not the surname He.
师 is the title element “master/teacher” in 大贤良师, not the surname Shi.
广 means broadly or widely in 广收门徒, not the radical description.
The pinyin includes 方, which is outside this segment.
方 means groups, districts, or units here, not the surname Fang.
当立 means should or is destined to establish/stand, not an onomatopoeia.
立 means establish or stand here, not the surname Li.
派 means dispatch/send in 派马元义, not the unrelated dictionary example.
带 means bring or carry here, not band.
被 is the passive marker in 被斩, not “quilt.”
起兵 means raise or launch troops; 起 does not simply mean rise in this context.
将军 means general or military commander in these titles, not a place name.
称 means call or designate here, not fit.
将军 means general or military commander in this title, not a place name.
将军 means general or military commander in this title, not a place name.
万 means ten thousand here, not a form used in a personal name.
路 means route or separate route in 分路讨伐, not the surname Lu.
